distribution.summary: 重庆；福建；广东；广西；海南；江西；西藏；云南；香港
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Fujian, Guangdong and Xizang; 黄复生等 (2015) adds Hainan. Smith et al. (2020) confirms those areas and adds Chongqing, Guangxi, Jiangxi and Yunnan. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Baseline host records Ficus chlorocarpa and Machilus sp. are retained. Smith et al. (2020) adds no host in the promoted record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hadrodemius pseudocomans (Eggers, 1930).

taxonomic_history.name: Xyleborus artecomans
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 24.

taxonomic_history.name: Hadrodemius pseudocomans
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) uses Xyleborus artecomans and 黄复生等 (2015) uses Hadrodemius artecomans. Smith et al. (2020) treats the stable taxon as Hadrodemius pseudocomans; canonical authorship follows integrated taxonomic backbone: (Eggers, 1930), VSN_2869.
